About OKC Kitchen & Bath

OKC Kitchen & Bath is a design-focused home renovation company in Oklahoma City offering full-service remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, and whole homes. Guided by integrity and craftsmanship, our team elevates interiors through intentional design and expert renovation.

Meet the OKC Kitchen & Bath Team

 

Ryan Johnson

Owner & Head of Construction

Cynjn Johnson

Owner & Head of
Pre-Construction

Mel Wanzer

Senior Designer

Chandler Francis

Director of Field Operations

Our Core Values

We believe your home should be a living work of art where purpose, comfort, and beauty converge. Our remodeling services are guided by five core values that define who we are and how we work.

1. Excellence in Everything
Our work, our growth, and our relationships are all shaped by a continuous pursuit of better. Our clients see this reflected in every home renovation project.
2. People-Focused

We build lasting relationships rooted in respect, empathy, and care. That’s care for clients, partners, and one another. Every renovation begins with people in mind.

3. Right Things, Right Way

We hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity and quality, treating every home as if it were our own. Doing things right means caring deeply about both the process and the outcome.

4. We Are Artists

We blend imagination and innovation with skilled craftsmanship to create designs that inspire. Each project is an opportunity to push creative boundaries while honoring timeless design.

5. Present in the Work

We give our full selves to the work before us, approaching each moment with intention, focus, and pride.

“The best team! Incredible designs and great craftsmanship! Couldn’t have asked for anyone better!”

– Kylie J., Norman

Learn About Our Process

Every renovation begins with a conversation. We partner with homeowners across Oklahoma City to bring full-service luxury renovations to life. Our team is proud to deliver an experience rooted in craftsmanship, collaboration, and care.

pages.text:
About
 
Services
 
Portfolio
 
Contact
Elevated Home Renovations Across the OKC Metro
Every remodeling project begins with a conversation about how you want your home to feel. We guide the planning and build stages with care so that every detail stays organized and aligned with your vision.
Begin Your Project
Our Design & Remodel Process
Step 1:
Project Discovery Call
Our process begins with a discovery call. We’ll discuss your goals and budget to ensure we’re the right partner for you. This conversation helps set the foundation for a thoughtful, well-planned home renovation.
Step 2:
In-Home Consultation
Next, we’ll visit your space to take a closer look and walk through all of the possibilities in more detail. This allows us to better understand your home and begin shaping a clear direction for your remodel.
Step 3:
Proposal Meeting
Then, you’ll be invited to our Midtown Oklahoma City office to review a proposal and discuss a preliminary visual direction with our in-house designer. This meeting will also cover project scope, expectations, and our process.
Step 4:
Design Direction & Material Selections
Once the proposal is approved, we’ll move into a series of in-person design meetings as part of our unique design-build approach. Together, we’ll refine the details, review inspiration, and develop mood boards with curated material options for your approval to ensure every element aligns with your vision.
Step 5:
Layout Planning & Final Details
Before construction begins, we’ll hold a “cabinet meeting” at your home focused on sizing, spacing, and functionality. The goal is to refine the layout for seamless daily life, from appliances to functional storage and flow.
Step 6:
Construction Begins
With planning and selections complete, we’ll move into the build phase. This is where your vision comes to life. Our team handles your renovation with care and clear communication, following the agreed-upon direction established in the pre-construction process.
Step 7:
Enjoy Your Finished Space
Once the renovation is done, we complete a detailed cleaning and walkthrough to confirm the space is finished and fully functional. Then, we celebrate this exciting new chapter for your home and family together.
Full-Service Home Renovations

We handle whole-home remodels that update your space while ensuring consistent, thoughtful design throughout. Our team creates cohesive interiors that are elevated, personal, and planned around the way you live.

View Our Work
Kitchen Renovations

Our kitchens are made for memorable moments and turning routine into enjoyment. From layout and lighting to custom cabinetry and finishes, we create spaces that seamlessly blend elegance and functionality in the heart of your home.

Bathroom Renovations

We design bathrooms that evoke calm and comfort through timeless materials and thoughtful details. Whether you envision a serene retreat or a more classic layout, our renovation team brings harmony and refinement to every project.

Ready to Begin Your Home Renovation?
As one of Oklahoma City’s leading remodeling teams, we specialize in creating elegant, functional spaces through a process defined by craftsmanship and collaboration. Share your goals with us, and we’ll bring your vision to life with precision and artistry.

pages.text:
About
 
Services
 
Portfolio
 
Contact
Luxury Full-Service Renovations in Oklahoma City

We create elegant spaces through thoughtful design, expert craftsmanship, and a renovation process defined by care and precision.

The Stone Gate Lodge
This whole-home renovation brought together soapstone, white oak, unlacquered brass and handmade tile in a space designed to feel curated rather than decorated. The kitchen was expanded and redesigned around a roman clay vent hood and materials chosen to patina over time, while the bathroom was opened up to include a soaking tub and a 10-foot floating vanity. Refinished hickory, iron railings and a pair of new iron doors complete this home transformation.
The Modern Haven Kitchen

Crisp white cabinetry, soft gray tones, and rich wood floors create a kitchen remodel that feels both timeless and inviting.

The Evergreen Kitchen & Bath

Muted green cabinetry, warm accents, and marble-inspired tile bring harmony and refinement to this thoughtfully crafted home renovation.

The Walnut Cove Residence

Dark cabinetry, brass fixtures, and soft stone surfaces combine in a kitchen and bath transformation defined by contrast, texture, and enduring elegance.

The Foster Home

In this dramatic bathroom remodel, black tile, and soft lighting evoke a sense of moody, modern sophistication.

Bring Your Vision to Life
From the first conversation to the final reveal, we’re here to guide you through a seamless, design-driven remodeling experience.
Begin Your Project
